messages:
Priya (Product): Quick question  Im planning to relocate with family to Barcelona for ~12 weeks this fall but will stay on US payroll. Do I still qualify for the monthly WFH stipend while abroad? Also want to bring my adjustable chair and monitor  any shipping or customs rules I should know?

Ravi (People Ops): Short answer: stipend is typically prorated for temporary relocations under 90 days. For 12 weeks (84 days) youre under the 90d payroll/localization threshold but we run Legal checks for EU stints. Shipping of home office items is reimbursable with receipts and pre-approval for >$500. Please submit the temp-remote form with dates, items, and manager sign-off.

Priya (Product): Thanks. Who signs off on shipping? Any typical caps for monitor/chair?

Ravi (People Ops): Manager sign-off + People Ops approval. We generally pre-approve up to $700 for combined desk/chair/monitor shipping; above that needs Finance review. Attach courier quote.

Marta (Legal): Legal note: company nexus risk is low for a single employee on a short stint, but confirm you wont be hosting customers or running local contracts. Personal tax residency in Spain changes at 183 days, so 84 days is safe on that front. Well do a quick jurisdiction check when form submitted.

Diego (Payroll): Payroll note: If you remain on US payroll stipend stays in USD. If Legal flags localization we may need to migrate payroll which can delay payments. Make sure your tax docs are current.

Priya (Product): Okay will file the form today (dates: Oct 1  Dec 24). Ill attach FedEx quotes and manager sign-off.

Ravi (People Ops): Great. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/temp-remote-form. Once submitted we tag it "EU short-term" and Legal/Payroll review. Expect reply within 48 business hours.

PeopleOps Bot: Form received: TR-2026-2145. Status: pending manager sign-off. Automation: >=90d triggers payroll/localization workflow.

Priya (Product): Thanks all  will update when manager signs.
